description: This file defines a custom exception class 'XliffFileProcessFailedException' within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It extends the base PHP Exception class and provides static methods to create instances with specific error messages related to XLIFF file processing failures.

classes.name: XliffFileProcessFailedException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors during XLIFF file processing in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: validationFailed
methods.description: Creates an instance of the exception indicating validation failure of the XLIFF file.

methods.name: emptyFile
methods.description: Creates an instance of the exception indicating the XLIFF file is empty.

methods.name: missingTargetLanguage
methods.description: Creates an instance of the exception indicating the target language attribute is missing in the XLIFF file.

methods.name: invalidTargetLanguage
methods.description: Creates an instance of the exception indicating the target language does not match the expected language.
